counters.headline: Full refund, first line
counters.hook: Full refund if your mornings don't change.
counters.offer: Money-back trial stated in the first line
counters.visual_direction: Hand holding a mug beside a handwritten note reading FULL REFUND, soft daylight
counters.why_it_beats: Two of these ads mention the 60-day guarantee, both late, and neither leads with it. This one does.

counters.headline: Black Friday stock-up
counters.hook: Black Friday: stock up on your morning focus.
counters.offer: Black Friday stock-up bundle, named in line one
counters.visual_direction: Three pouches stacked on a kitchen counter at sunrise, bold BLACK FRIDAY STOCK-UP headline
counters.why_it_beats: Their #01 ad says 58% off in the video, but none of these ads name Black Friday, said or written. This one puts the sale in the first line.
